message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Deploy mfa:admin and mfa:dbadmin together. MFA for admins blocks authentication to both DC and ADFS, so admin_dc and admin_adfs remain false. MFA for database admins then blocks authentication to the database, fileserver, and backup, even if CI secrets yield stolen_dbadmin. Thus no exfiltration technique can become available. No single control suffices: mfa:admin alone leaves the CI secrets route open; mfa:dbadmin alone can be bypassed through DC or ADFS admin access; segmentation alone can be bypassed by escalating a phished workstation or laptop; and any single patch or mfa:user leaves an alternative attack path."}
